name: rny-edusuite
description: RnY EduSuite — multi-tenant School ERP SaaS + animated school website (demo tenant: Raj English School, Varanasi)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix server run db:push && npm --prefix server run db:seed
